name: 2026 Women's Runback Brewing Club Championship FALL Qualifier | Zone 12-13 (Restricted)
description:
**Restricted Zone Qualifier to advance one team per qualifier. Random seeded double knockout draw.**

- All team members must also register once per season as a participant of Curling Ontario at https://on.curling.io/en/products/10513-curling-ontario-participant-registration-2026-2027
- Please see the eligibility rules to ensure your team is eligible to play in this event: https://www.curling.ca/events/competitor-information/competitor-eligibility/
- Additional eligibility requirements may apply - see Competitor Guide posted at https://curlingontario.ca/competitions/competition-regulations/ for details. 
- Registration in this competition also requires payment of a Curling Canada High Performance Fee of $40 per team and an Ontario High Performance Fee of $20 per team. **This fee will be automatically added on at check out, but is not reflected in the total below.** HST is not charged on high performance fees.

**Runback Brewing Club Championships Qualifying Options for 2026**

Teams have a choice between two qualifying windows for the Runback Brewing Club Championships:

- Spring Qualifying was held April 10–12 with 6 Zone Qualifiers (1 team advanced from each)
- Fall Qualifying will be held October 16–18 with 6 Zone Qualifiers (1 team advances from each)

**Key Registration Details:**

- Teams must choose one qualifying event or the other, but cannot enter both qualifier weekends.
- Your club can still enter up to two teams per gender **TOTAL** combined between Spring and Fall Qualifying. 
- Teams from the same club do not have to attend the same qualifier weekend.

Communications will be sent to all participants for which a valid email address is provided. Please have this information ready when completing your team registration.

**Withdrawals and Refunds**

- Should a team enter a Curling Ontario qualifier and choose to withdraw from an event prior to the entry deadline they will receive a refund, less 10% to cover processing fees.
- To mitigate the disruption caused by last-minute alterations, Teams who choose to change qualifiers forfeit their original entry fee and must pay another full entry fee to register for the new qualifier of their choice.
- Teams cannot change qualifiers after the entry deadline. There are no refunds for teams who withdraw after the entry deadline. 
- To change your qualifier you must register for the new one you’d like to participate in BY THE REGISTRATION DEADLINE and email competitions@curlingontario.ca to request to be removed from the one you no longer wish to participate in.
- If a team withdraws after the draw schedule has been released that team’s games will be replaced with byes.

**New to competition, or looking for a refresher?**

- Read: Rules Ready, Game On! A Guide to Provincial Qualifying and Championship Play Click to get the guide: https://docs.google.com/document/d/16OMET7c0sfa6i3zzLcPuL6X536Bdolwb99BOv4uu-8E/edit?usp=sharing
